name: InkPath
description: An affordable, ESIGN/UETA-aligned e-signature engine for Salesforce CRE teams.

APP_BASE_URL.description: Public https URL of this Heroku app (e.g. https://inkpath.herokuapp.com).

SF_USERNAME.description: Salesforce integration user to impersonate via JWT bearer.

SF_PRIVATE_KEY.description: PEM private key matching the Connected App certificate (newlines may be escaped as \n).

BACKEND_API_KEY.description: Shared secret guarding the sender API. Must match the x-api-key custom header on the Salesforce External Credential. Required in production.
